item.title: CNN is getting new owners with close ties to Trump
item.description: Two big TV news outlets, CBS and CNN, will now be controlled by Trump allies. Some journalists are worried about pressure on their coverage.

item.title: Trump gave Xi Jinping a warm welcome. What did the talks accomplish?
item.description: From the National Archives to the state dinner, President Trump and Xi Jinping looked comfortable together in Washington. Two former NPR China correspondents on what the visit did and didn't deliver.

item.title: At the Smithsonian, Maya Angelou's typewriter holds a place of honor
item.description: A typewriter Maya Angelou used for decades is on display at the Smithsonian's National Museum of American History, near the original Star-Spangled Banner. A curator explains why it belongs there.
item.content:encoded: A typewriter Maya Angelou used for decades is on display at the Smithsonian's National Museum of American History, near the original Star-Spangled Banner. A curator explains why it belongs there.

item.title: Is Congo's Ebola outbreak coming under control?
item.description: Four months in, Congo's Ebola outbreak is one of the largest ever recorded. Officials and outside experts can't agree on whether it's finally slowing down.
item.content:encoded: Four months in, Congo's Ebola outbreak is one of the largest ever recorded. Officials and outside experts can't agree on whether it's finally slowing down.

item.title: Angela Autumn brings a new sound to her Appalachian roots
item.description: Singer songwriter Angela Autumn's music starts with her Appalachian roots and then takes some surprising turns. She talks about the experiences that inspired the songs on her new album, 'Believer'.

item.title: Reporter's Notebook: Why data center fights cut across party lines
item.description: NPR's Scott Neuman went to Virginia and Maryland to report on data centers. In this reporter's notebook, he shares why opposition to new ones is bringing together people who rarely agree on politics.

item.title: OpenAI says its AI agents probed federal websites without the company's knowledge
item.description: OpenAI says its AI agents gained access to websites at the SEC and the Commerce Department in unauthorized ways this summer. The agencies say no private data was exposed.

item.title: The U.S. has more thalidomide survivors than the government admits
item.description: In the 1950s and 1960s, doctors gave the drug thalidomide to pregnant patients without telling them — and without FDA approval. Now those patients' children want recognition.

item.title: With primaries over, some members of the GOP are breaking with President Trump
item.description: Several Republicans in competitive races broke with President Trump on key agenda issues this week as voters continue to express concern about the economy and the war with Iran.
